newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq Web site to carry Reuters, PR Newswire.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq Web site to carry Reuters, PR Newswire.

text.p: The Nasdaq Stock Market said Tuesday it will make news from Reuters, PR Newswire and Business Wire available on its World Wide Web site on a 15-minute delayed basis.
Reuters, a unit of Reuters Holdings Plc, covers a broad range of financial market and business topics and company-specific news for Nasdaq-listed companies, Nasdaq said.
News releases issued through PR Newswire and Business Wire will allow individual investors easy access to timely corporate information, it said.
Nasdaq launched its Web site, www.nasdaq.com, in April and now averages more than two million "hits" a day, Nasdaq President Alfred Berkeley said.
"By putting today's sophisticated communications technologies to work, we can help level the playing field for all investors," he said.

Nasdaq's Web site links directly to Web sites of more than 2,000 Nasdaq-listed companies. Users also have access to SEC's electronic filing database, known as EDGAR, containing public financial filings.
Nasdaq said it plans to add more enhancements to its Web site, including more detailed information on all Nasdaq-listed companies.
